title: How To Call A Menu On A Webpage | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How To Call A Menu On A Webpage Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000034726 In this article, you will learn how to call a menu on a webpage or within a widget. To do this, navigate to Toolbox >> Widget Manager , then click Copy Shortcode under Actions for the desired menu. In this example, the shortcode from the Side by Side Pricing Menu ( add-on ) is used. After copying the shortcode, it can be used on any webpage or widget. For this example, the menu is added to a new webpage with the URL /pricing-test . Navigate to Content >> Web Page Builder and click New Web Page . Paste the copied shortcode into the content area, assign a unique URL, and click Save Web Page . The menu will render automatically on the new webpage. The same approach can be used to display a menu inside a widget. Copy the shortcode for the desired menu and paste it into the HTML tab of a custom or default widget.
